summary: When a Fabric tunnel closes, st asks `fabric probe --json` whether the member refused it, and puts only a refusal-class route to sleep.

schema.detail: No tables, columns, indexes or triggers.

rules.detail: Checkpoint rules and digests are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: After an exchange over a Fabric route fails at the connection, the replication worker runs `fabric probe PEER SERVICE --json` and reads its `code` and `class`. A Fabric older than 0.2.41 prints no `code` or `class`, so st reads the two old refusal phrases in its `error` text, in the same legacy fallback as the dial path. No wire change. Fabric exec of a program now retries a few times on `text file busy`.
